name: @red-cup-engineering/name-relation-admissibility-service
description: Transforms a punctuated-name derivation (the RMN term produced by punctuated-name-derivation-service — mark(atom), or nested pair(previous, pair(mark(relation), mark(atom))) per step) plus a caller-supplied admitted-relations table into {admitted: true} or {admitted: false, refusedAtStep, reason}: the paper's Section 7 Adm(A, mark, B) relation, checked against the term's own structure, not merely asserted. The table is DATA the caller passes in from a content record — never hardcoded here — because K_valid is specific to each system's own domain, not to this convention.
